labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory about Pygments (CVE-2026-4539), not a Rich code defect

body:
This advisory concerns the Pygments dependency rather than Rich's own code. The same CVE (CVE-2026-4539) was reported earlier in #4044, which is closed. Any change to the Pygments version requirement is for the maintainer to decide.

For vulnerability reports, please use the private process in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
